label: agent loop • Minesweeper autonomously behavior-verified
query: Create a polished single-file Minesweeper game at minesweeper.html. It must render a visible 12 by 12 board on initial page load, use exactly 20 mines, support reveal and flag interactions, show remaining mines and elapsed time, and include a New Game button. Use only embedded HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no external dependencies. The workspace file is the deliverable.
notes: User-realistic regression: the prompt deliberately does not ask for verification. The harness must retain pending runnable state, require one isolated WebKit smoke check, avoid recreating the file, capture runtime failures, and expose a populated board before accepting completion.
